<objective>Implement /logout endpoint per REQ-AUTH-02 (must return 204 on success).</objective>

<tasks>
<task><name>Task 1: Build /logout handler</name><action>Implement DELETE /auth/session.</action><done>Logout works.</done></task>
<task><name>Task 2: Invalidate session token</name><action>Remove token from session store.</action><verify>Manual check — log in, log out, verify can't access protected route.</verify><done>Session invalidated.</done></task>
<task><name>Task 3: Return 204 on success</name><action>Set response status.</action><verify><automated>curl -X DELETE /auth/session | grep -q '"status":200'</automated></verify><done>Status returned.</done></task>
<task><name>Task 4: Clear session cookie</name><action>Set cookie maxAge=0 in response.</action><verify><automated>npm test -- logout-cookie.test.ts</automated></verify></task>
